notes.title: Refining Update – Work in Progress!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!



We’re excited to share that we’ve just started working on the next major update for Timber Panic! This one will give your logs a brand-new purpose beyond simply selling them. You’ll soon be able to refine your wood into something more valuable and unlock new ways to put your forest finds to good use. 



We don’t want to spoil too much yet, but let’s just say this update will bring more reasons to chop, collect, and enjoy your cozy yard. It’s still early in development, so we’ll keep sharing progress as things come together.



And there’s one more thing 👉 Timber Panic will be part of Steam Next Fest 🎉 We can’t wait to share the game with new players, hear your feedback, and keep improving the experience together.



Stay cozy,

SplitBit Team 🪓
